decisions.reason: Changing who configures the JLCPCB orders does not alter the required BOM contents or board-specific BOM obligation.
Account-based order setup may facilitate orientation checking, but it does not change the existing requirement to verify component orientations in JLCPCB.
The order-configuration workflow does not change connector pin labeling or its board location.
Adding board orders to the client's account does not change which production export files are required.
The assignment of JLCPCB order-configuration work does not modify component sourceability or compatible-alternative rules.
The JLCPCB account workflow has no effect on the charge-status LED circuit or connector requirements.
The order-configuration actor and method do not change the interboard power topology, connectors, or pin semantics.
The manufacturing-order workflow does not alter the requirement that all sensor-board content fit on the board.
The JLCPCB order setup decision does not modify the panel power-button interface.
The order-placement workflow does not affect DCDC1 voltage regulation or its compensation purpose.
Adding board configurations to the client's account does not change ESP32 breakout coverage or format.
The manufacturing-order configuration workflow does not modify interboard signal connectors or pinouts.
